Markets.title: Yes Bank bondholders press for compliance with Supreme Court's AT-1 order
Markets.summary: Axis Trustee Services filed a contempt petition in the Supreme Court after Yes Bank failed to comply with an order reversing the write-off of 84 billion rupees in AT-1 bonds. The petition asks the court to enforce its previous ruling that set aside the bond write-off.

Markets.title: Anthropic’s IPO is said to be multiple times oversubscribed
Markets.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering is multiple times oversubscribed as it targets up to $90.4 billion in funding. The strong investor demand reflects an anticipated market valuation of around $1.4 trillion, supported by an $81 billion revenue run rate.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Astra Microwave among 3 stock recommendations for Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities opened higher on positive global cues but later surrendered gains due to rising bond yields and hawkish Federal Reserve commentary. Analysts recommended focusing on stock-specific opportunities, including Astra Microwave and Neogen, for Thursday's trading session.

Markets.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq rise as CoreWeave results ease AI spending concerns
Markets.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose after CoreWeave reported strong financial results and projected profitability by 2028. This performance eased investor concerns about artificial intelligence spending and boosted AI infrastructure stocks.

Markets.title: Baird downgrades Nvidia on China curbs, AI demand worries
Markets.summary: Baird downgraded Nvidia's stock and cut its price target due to market risks, including US restrictions on chip sales to China and softening demand. Additionally, multiple brokerages have removed Nvidia from their top picks amid supply constraints and uncertainty.

Markets.title: EasyJet shareholders approve £5.7 billion Apollo takeover
Markets.summary: EasyJet shareholders overwhelmingly voted to approve a £5.7 billion takeover by Apollo, which would take the airline off the London stock market. The deal, targeted for completion in the first quarter of next year, still faces regulatory scrutiny in the European Union over airline ownership rules.

Geo-Political.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of people joined a general strike in Barcelona organized by Spain's main unions to protest housing costs and the high cost of living. Clashes erupted during the demonstrations.

Geo-Political.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate race in surprise victory for party
Geo-Political.summary: Democrat Scott Colom won a surprise victory in the Mississippi Senate race. His win makes him the first Black person elected to the U.S. Senate from Mississippi in more than 140 years.

Geo-Political.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
Geo-Political.summary: Recent talks in Abu Dhabi focused on Europe's post-war security framework but concluded without a breakthrough. United States envoys are scheduled to meet with Vladimir Putin and Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Thursday.

Geo-Political.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
Geo-Political.summary: More than 6,000 schools in Italy, Scotland, and Northern Ireland received bomb threats that authorities suspect are hoaxes. Officials in all three regions stated that there appears to be no actual risk to the public.

Geo-Political.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
Geo-Political.summary: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has resigned from office. This resignation highlights a growing political rift between President Prabowo Subianto and former President Joko Widodo.

Geo-Political.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
Geo-Political.summary: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a 74-year-old former member of the Red Brigades guerrilla group, escaped house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from a balcony. His escape occurred just as he was about to be extradited to Italy.

Data & Insights.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
Data & Insights.summary: Moody’s has raised India's fiscal year 2027 growth forecast to 7%. The agency expects this economic growth rate to continue through 2028 due to strong domestic demand and resilience.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's ups India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum, warns of risks
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7% due to strong momentum and resilience. However, the agency warned that inflation, deficient monsoons, and El Niño risks could threaten this growth.

Data & Insights.title: Scientific research and granular data key to tackling climate, food security challenges: PK Mishra
Data & Insights.summary: PK Mishra stated that climate change goes beyond environmental issues to directly impact agriculture, water, food prices, health, and livelihoods. He emphasized that addressing these challenges requires scientific research and granular data.

Data & Insights.title: How the government finance math looks more challenging in H2 FY27
Data & Insights.summary: The central government's fiscal position weakened during the first half of fiscal year 27 while remaining within manageable limits. The second half of the year will likely be more challenging due to a fading dividend cushion and stricter targets for spending and income tax collections.

Data & Insights.title: Thirsty farms, slowing turbines: how depleting dams threaten power, harvest
Data & Insights.summary: India's depleted reservoirs and dry monsoon have reduced the acreage for key rabi crops like wheat, rice, and pulses. This water shortage is threatening both national agriculture and hydropower generation.

Data & Insights.title: Explainer: What is Mawan Terminal? How China’s high-tech ports could change how 80% of global trade moves
Data & Insights.summary: China is upgrading Shenzhen’s Mawan Terminal and other facilities to lead the digital transformation of global shipping. Beijing currently operates 60 automated terminals and plans to increase that number to 90 by 2030.

India.title: "Farmers Always Top Priority": PM As Cabinet Clears Rabi Fertiliser Subsidy
India.summary: Prime Minister Modi stated that farmers remain the government's top priority despite challenging global circumstances. The Union Cabinet approved a subsidy for Rabi fertilizers to help improve farmers' lives.

India.title: Amul Milk Prices To Go Up By Rs 2-4 Per Litre From Today
India.summary: Amul is increasing its fresh milk prices by Rs 2 to Rs 4 per litre starting today. The exact price increase depends on the specific milk variant.

India.title: No Rain, No Relief: Weather Chief Dashes Pollution-Hit Delhi's Hopes
India.summary: Delhi residents hoping for rain to clear the severe toxic pollution have been disappointed. The weather office has stated that no rainfall is expected in the plains, including Delhi.

India.title: Delhi Boy Falls Into Sewer, Dismembered Body Found In Water Treatment Plant
India.summary: A young boy fell into an open manhole in southwest Delhi on Tuesday afternoon, prompting a massive multi-agency search operation. His dismembered body was later discovered at a water treatment plant.

India.title: Punjab Cop Faces Probe After Viral Video Shows Heroin Found In His Pocket
India.summary: A Punjab Police officer is facing an investigation after a viral video allegedly showed heroin in his pocket. The incident has raised concerns about the force's credibility during its ongoing anti-drug campaign.

India.title: 'Is Sex Available?' Rapido Driver Asked Woman. Company Responds To Viral Post
India.summary: A Rapido driver inappropriately asked a female passenger if sex was available during a ride. The company responded to the viral post by verifying the incident and permanently removing the driver from its platform.

General.title: Author says there were 'real concerns' about David Walliams within publishing industry
General.summary: An author stated that the publishing industry had "real concerns" about David Walliams over ten years ago. Walliams has denied allegations of sexual misconduct, inappropriate behavior, and abuse of power.

General.title: 'I felt like I was being manipulated': Woman alleges Walliams groomed her as a teenager
General.summary: Lilly Creightmore told BBC Newsnight that she felt manipulated and angry after being allegedly groomed by Walliams as a teenager. Walliams has not yet addressed these specific allegations made public in the interview.

General.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
General.summary: Tens of thousands of people in Spain joined a general strike organized by the country's main unions to protest housing costs and the high cost of living. Clashes subsequently erupted during the demonstrations in Barcelona.

General.title: Hegseth and advisers reprimanded by guard at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
General.summary: A US Army sentinel shouted at Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and his advisers to be quiet at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The reprimand occurred following a Veterans Day wreath-laying ceremony.

General.title: Thousands of schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
General.summary: Thousands of schools across Italy, Scotland, and Northern Ireland received bomb threats that authorities suspect are hoaxes. Officials in all three countries report that there is currently no risk to the public.

General.title: Scottish DJ, 32, confirmed as victim of Krakow shooting
General.summary: A 32-year-old Scottish DJ, identified as James Thomas Campbell from Prestwick, was shot and killed by a lone gunman in central Krakow. The fatal shooting occurred on Saturday.
